integrity: The claim is supported by an analytic Poisson-mixture and size-biased Dirichlet proof. No finite experiment is presented as an infinite proof. The network-formation interpretation is explicitly not an equilibrium claim.
scientific_limitations: Single seeded cascade on a cycle in the scaling \(p_n=1-\lambda/n\); no equilibrium classification or generalization to other graph families. The exact first/second-moment literature is a residual risk for the welfare corollary, and a general finite-graph percolation method covers finite-size distributions in principle.
title: Critical-window survival law for a randomly attacked cycle
